subject: Ava Solutions — temporary PO carveout for trial onboarding
messages:
From: Jordan Miles <jordan.miles@avasolutions.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 9 Dec 2027 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Onboarding question — temporary invoice path for short trial

Hi Marissa,

Quick question — we want to get a short technical trial of Redwood running next week to validate latency and embedding throughput for a PoC. Our procurement team will require a standard PO for ongoing suppliers, but the trial is time-boxed (4–6 weeks) and our internal process will take longer to generate a PO.

Would Redwood consider a temporary invoice-only onboarding (no PO) for the trial period so we can start next week? We can provide a signed SOW and a finance contact for invoice routing. If needed, we can commit to creating a PO before any extended production usage.

Attached: AVA_SOW_v1.pdf (statement of work)

If there are standard conditions you need (e.g., credit checks, evidence, a capped spend), let us know and we can align quickly.

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Miles
Technical Program Manager, Ava Solutions
jordan.miles@avasolutions.com
+1 415 555 0123

Date: Thu, 9 Dec 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Onboarding question — temporary invoice path for short trial

Hi Jordan — thanks for the note and for sharing the SOW. Uploading the SOW and starting the trial next week is doable, but we need to agree a short exception workflow so Finance and Procurement are comfortable.

TL;DR — provisional invoice-only onboarding for up to 60 days is possible with the following conditions:
- Signed SOW on file (we need the digital sig)
- Procurement exception form completed (I attached the template)
- Maximum trial spend capped at $15,000 unless otherwise approved
- Invoices routed to the finance email you provide; Net30 standard applies
- PO must be issued before any extension past 60 days or before production rollout

I'm looping in Priyom from Procurement and Karthik from Finance to confirm any additional controls (credit, tax/VAT). Please complete the attached procurement-exception-form.xlsx and return it with the signed SOW. Also confirm the accounting contact for invoice delivery.

If Procurement/Finance are comfortable, we can mark this as a temporary carveout and issue an internal approval record. If anything changes (late payment or missing PO by the extension date) we will pause access.

Attachment: procurement-exception-form.xlsx (fill and return)

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Lead | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

We completed the SOW with our legal team and can provide the signed copy (digital signature accepted). Attaching: AVA_SOW_signed.pdf

2) Any chance Redwood can issue a single consolidated invoice at the end of the trial rather than periodic invoices? Our AP prefers one invoice per engagement.

Hi Jordan / Marissa — procurement and finance have reviewed. We are provisionally approving a 60-day invoice-only onboarding for Ava Solutions with these binding conditions: 

1) Signed SOW accepted — AVA_SOW_signed.pdf received and uploaded to the deal record. Digital signature via DocuSign is acceptable.
2) Trial spend cap — $15,000 (system will enforce alerts once 80% threshold is reached).
3) Invoice cadence — Redwood will issue a single consolidated invoice at the end of the trial period unless you request interim billing. Please confirm in writing if you prefer interim invoices.
4) Procurement exception form — please upload completed procurement-exception-form.xlsx. We need vendor tax ID and remit address fields filled; if unknown, provide a confirmed contact who will supply the info within 7 days.
5) PO deadline — a formal PO must be in place before 2028-02-01 for the relationship to continue past the 60-day carveout. If no PO is received by that date, we will suspend the account until PO is provided.
6) VAT/withholding — Karthik, please follow up on tax handling (cc'd).

I've attached the internal approval record (po-exception-approval-record.pdf) for audit. This message constitutes the official exception approval and will be logged against deal AVA-TRIAL-2027-11.

Next steps for Jordan: upload the filled procurement-exception-form.xlsx and confirm accounting@avasolutions.com as the remit contact. Karthik — can you confirm the VAT treatment and whether we need a W-8/W-9?

Thanks — Priyom
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.com
